text.arabic_uthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوا۟ ۖ لَهُۥ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ أَبْصِرْ بِهِۦ وَأَسْمِعْ ۚ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِى حُكْمِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: imperative speech command that turns the prior dispute into a delivered answer
words.root_gloss_range: local command sense; broader root questions are not activated beyond the command form
words.prose: {{ar:قُلِ}} ({{tr:quli}}) opens the ayah as an imperative speech act. The command makes the Prophet the answer channel, draws the duration dispute into direct proclamation, and audibly binds the command to the named divine subject that follows. Same-surah command echoes at 18:24, 18:29, 18:109, and 18:110 keep this as part of a larger commanded-disclosure pattern.

topics.headline: commanded dispute closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer is not a detached report but a commanded public utterance through the Prophet.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on this local payoff, and the QAC alignment plus reference evidence support preserving it at the stated scope.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as explicit subject and antecedent for later suffixes
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship, refuge, and awe pressures; not a generic deity category here
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) stands as the explicit subject of the opening nominal claim. The proper name prevents a generic deity reading and becomes the antecedent for later pronouns in ownership, perception, exclusion, and governance. The move from the relational frame in 18:22 to the proper divine name here broadens the answer into absolute authority.

topics.headline: named divine center for the whole ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah fixes one named referent before every later predicate and pronoun unfolds.

words.gloss_range: comparative or superlative knowing, locally specified by the following content phrase
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, marking, and sign range; local sense is knowing with a faint decisiveness of true measure
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:aʿlamu}}) is the predicate of the named divine subject, with elative force that can be heard as better knowing and as most knowing. The following content phrase keeps the claim from floating as generic omniscience: it answers the concrete duration question while also preparing the wider unseen-ownership claim. The recurrence of this knowledge-duration pairing in 18:12, 18:19, 18:22, and 18:26 turns the cave chronology into an epistemic hierarchy.

topics.headline: elative knowledge answers the dispute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowing is both superior to human estimates and specifically aimed at the disputed duration.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the content or specification of knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the elative predicate to its content. Here the particle marks specification, not instrument, so the phrase narrows divine knowledge to what the sleepers remained. Its position immediately after the predicate keeps the answer tied to the dispute.

topics.headline: content marker narrows knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the knowledge claim is scoped to the exact contested matter rather than left abstract.

words.gloss_range: relative element carrying what or how-long force without naming the unit
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) functions as the relative element after the specification particle. It can carry the pressure of what they remained and how long they remained without naming the unit, so the unresolved measure from 18:25 is not settled by another number but placed inside what God knows.

topics.headline: relative word absorbs duration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the duration is held open grammatically and transferred into divine knowledge.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural remaining, used absolutely without local duration or location complements
words.root_gloss_range: remaining, tarrying, and being held in place; local use presents the sleepers duration as completed and withheld
words.prose: {{ar:لَبِثُوا}} ({{tr:labithū}}) completes the relative phrase with a perfect plural verb. Against the measured wording of 18:25, this use is bare: no cave location and no duration phrase remain attached. The root pressure of tarrying or being held makes the span feel like endured suspension, while the perfect form makes that suspension a completed object of divine knowledge.

topics.headline: completed remaining with measure withheld

words.gloss_range: fronted possessive predicate assigning the following domain to Him
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the second beat with a fronted possessive predicate. The order puts belonging-to-Him before the hidden domain, so the phrase restricts ownership in advance and starts the chain that later denies alternative protectors and partners.

topics.headline: fronted possession restricts the unseen

words.gloss_range: verbal noun for hidden reality, delayed as subject and bound to the cosmic pair
words.root_gloss_range: absence, concealment, and perception-limit range; local sense is the owned unseen domain
words.prose: {{ar:غَيْبُ}} ({{tr:ghaybu}}) names hidden reality as a domain, not a list of unknown facts. Grammatically it comes after the fronted ownership phrase and enters construct with the heavens-and-earth pair, making the unseen belong to God across the whole cosmic field. This also answers the conjectural unseen talk of 18:22 by relocating hidden knowledge from human guessing to divine ownership.

topics.headline: hiddenness as owned cosmic domain

words.gloss_range: definite plural upper domains as first member of the cosmic pair
words.root_gloss_range: elevation and upperness range; local sense is the heavens as the elevated pole of totality
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) supplies the first dependent in the hidden-domain construct. Its definite plural form makes the upper realm a known totality, and together with the earth it forms the standard cosmic merism. The elevation image gives the hidden domain vertical reach before the wording grounds it in the lower pole.

topics.headline: upper domain in the cosmic merism

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining earth into the same governed cosmic phrase
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is not loose addition here. It coordinates the earth into the same genitive relation as the upper domains, turning the two nouns into one heavens-and-earth merism under the owned hidden domain.

topics.headline: connector makes one cosmic pair

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth as the lower pole of the cosmic pair
words.root_gloss_range: ground, land, and low-surface range; local sense is the earth as total lower domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) completes the cosmic merism as the lower, grounded pole. Its singular definite form compresses all terrain into one counterpart to the plural upper domains, so the phrase closes with total creation under divine hidden-knowledge ownership.

topics.headline: earth grounds the cosmic totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cosmic unseen is not only elevated but also grounded across the whole earth.

words.gloss_range: Form IV command shape functioning as an exclamation of excellent divine seeing
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceptual resolution, and insight range; local grammar selects exclamatory perception
words.prose: {{ar:أَبْصِرْ}} ({{tr:abṣir}}) looks morphologically like an imperative but functions as a wonder-form exclamation. The sight root brings perceptual resolution and insight, while the following formula particle prevents it from being read as a normal command. This central exclamation bridges the hidden-knowledge claim and the final denial of rival authority.

topics.headline: seeing becomes wonder-form praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah pivots from knowledge and ownership into wonder at divine perception.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on this local payoff, and the QAC alignment plus reference evidence support preserving it at the stated scope.

words.gloss_range: structural particle required by the exclamatory formula, with suffix referring back to God
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) completes the exclamatory formula after the sight verb. It is structural rather than instrumental, and its attached pronoun keeps the praise focused on the same divine antecedent. The construction can also carry forward by ellipsis to the paired hearing exclamation.

topics.headline: formula particle binds the exclamation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the seeing clause is a fixed exclamatory construction centered on the same divine referent.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on this local payoff, and the QAC alignment plus reference evidence support preserving it at the stated scope.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining two parallel perception exclamations
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second exclamation with the first without subordinating either. The effect is a paired perception formula: divine seeing and hearing stand together at the ayah center.

topics.headline: connector pairs sight and hearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sight and hearing are coordinated as a matched perception pair.

words.gloss_range: Form IV command shape functioning as a parallel exclamation of excellent divine hearing
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, reception, and transmitted knowledge range; local grammar selects exclamatory perception
words.prose: {{ar:أَسْمِعْ}} ({{tr:asmiʿ}}) mirrors the prior sight exclamation in Form IV command shape while functioning as praise, not instruction. Its object is not overt because the previous formula supplies the pattern, and the hearing root adds receptive perception to visual resolution. The recurring sight-hearing pair in 17:1, 22:75, 40:20, and 42:11 supports the total-perception force.

topics.headline: hearing mirrors the sight exclamation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine perception is totalized through hearing as well as sight.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on this local payoff, and the QAC alignment plus reference evidence support preserving it at the stated scope.

words.gloss_range: negative particle introducing the denied possession clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the final authority beat with categorical negation. It negates the possession clause that follows, so the line turns from divine perception to the created side: they have no protector apart from Him. Together with the later negation, it forms a two-part denial of external support and shared governance.

topics.headline: negation opens the authority denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final movement begins by denying that any alternative protector is available.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on this local payoff, and the QAC alignment plus reference evidence support preserving it at the stated scope.

words.gloss_range: possessive preposition attributing what is denied to the plural group
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) attributes possession to the plural group under negation. Its fronted position makes the lack belong to them before the denied protector appears, so the clause is not abstract; it names what is unavailable for that group.

topics.headline: possessor set before the denied item
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is placed before the protector is denied, sharpening the lack as theirs.

words.gloss_range: third-person plural pronoun for the sleepers with possible widening to created beings
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) routes the denied possession to a plural referent. Locally it points to the sleepers in the dispute, but the authority sequence and later universal denial allow the plural to widen toward created beings generally. The plural group contrasts with the repeated singular divine suffixes around it.

topics.headline: plural pronoun widens the denied lack
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied possession starts with the cave group and can widen toward all created dependents.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on this local payoff, and the QAC alignment plus reference evidence support preserving it at the stated scope.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking separation from any source apart from Him
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) governs the following exclusion phrase and marks separation rather than simple origin. It prepares the listener for a source outside Him to be ruled out, before a second particle intensifies the denial of any protector at all.

topics.headline: first separation marker starts exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause begins by excluding the direction from which help might be sought.

words.gloss_range: semi-prepositional phrase meaning below, short of, or apart from Him
words.root_gloss_range: belowness, subordination, and register range; local sense is hierarchical exclusion from divine authority
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِهِ}} ({{tr:dūnihi}}) forms the hierarchical exclusion phrase after the first separation marker. The suffix points back to the named divine subject, while the word itself marks what is below, short of, or apart from Him. Same-surah warnings, including 18:50, keep this phrase in the field of false-support exclusion.

topics.headline: beneath-or-apart phrase excludes rivals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that alternatives are not just absent but ranked beneath and apart from the divine referent.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle under negation making the indefinite noun universally denied
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is the second separation particle in the final negated phrase. Under negation before an indefinite noun, it makes the denial exhaustive: not even one protector remains available from the excluded zone.

topics.headline: second particle empties the protector class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording denies not just a known protector but any member of the protector class.

words.gloss_range: indefinite protector or patron under emphatic negation
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, protection, patronage, and governance range; local sense is any protecting authority denied
words.prose: {{ar:وَلِيٍّ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}) names the denied protector as an indefinite singular under reinforced negation. The root field joins nearness, protective authority, and patronage, so the clause denies more than casual help: it denies any close authority capable of guarding them apart from God. The same field is affirmed positively in 18:44, making this denial part of the surah authority pattern.

topics.headline: no close protecting authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied helper would have to be both near and authoritative, and that the wording excludes even one such figure.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on this local payoff, and the QAC alignment plus reference evidence support preserving it at the stated scope.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining two negative authority clauses
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins two negative authority clauses. Before it, the group lacks any protector apart from Him; after it, God does not share His governance with anyone. The connector therefore escalates from passive deficiency to active divine exclusivity.

topics.headline: connector escalates to divine non-sharing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final beat moves from human lack to God's own refusal to share governance.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on this local payoff, and the QAC alignment plus reference evidence support preserving it at the stated scope.

words.gloss_range: negative particle before indicative imperfect, stating divine non-sharing as fact
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the following imperfect verb as a declaration in the standard reading. Variant readings can show how a prohibition would sound, but the canonical clause states an ongoing fact: God does not share. This starts the second half of the final authority denial.

topics.headline: declarative negation, not prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause declares what God does not do rather than issuing a prohibition to someone else.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect denying that God admits anyone into partnership in His governance
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, partnership, co-ownership, and theological association range; local sense is admission into governance partnership denied
words.prose: {{ar:يُشْرِكُ}} ({{tr:yushriku}}) is a Form IV imperfect with God as subject. Its argument structure takes the governance phrase as the domain and the final anyone-word as the object, so the clause specifies both where sharing is denied and whom it excludes. The partnership root makes this more than consultation; it denies admitting any participant into a share of divine rule, and same-surah uses at 18:38, 18:42, and 18:110 keep the anti-association spine active.

topics.headline: Form IV refuses admission into partnership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb protects divine governance from being partitioned into shares or opened to any partner.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking governance as the domain where partnership is denied
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) marks the following governance noun as the domain of the denied partnership. It selects domain-containment rather than physical location, and its placement before the final object foregrounds jurisdiction before the excluded participant.

topics.headline: domain marker scopes the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the non-sharing is scoped to the jurisdiction of rule and judgment.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on this local payoff, and the QAC alignment plus reference evidence support preserving it at the stated scope.

words.gloss_range: possessed verbal noun for His judgment, governance, decree, and jurisdiction
words.root_gloss_range: judging, ruling, restraining, wisdom, and firmness range; local sense is divine binding governance
words.prose: {{ar:حُكْمِهِ}} ({{tr:ḥukmihi}}) is the governed domain after the preposition, with the suffix making it definitively His. As a verbal noun it can gather judging as act and governance as authority-domain, while the root field adds restraint, wisdom, and firmness. Cross-surah sovereignty formulas at 12:40, 12:67, 6:57, and 40:12 support the judicial-monopoly field, but this ayah states it negatively: no one is admitted into His rule.

topics.headline: His binding governance is the protected domain

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative object under negation, excluding any possible individual
words.root_gloss_range: one, anyone, and absolute uniqueness range; local sense is negative-polarity anyone under negation
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}) is the direct object of the non-sharing verb and lands as the final word. Its indefinite form under negation means no one whatsoever, not merely no known rival. The word also echoes 18:22 and anticipates 18:110, so the final cadence moves from human inquiry about anyone to divine sovereignty that admits no anyone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from أَعْلَمُ and غَيْبُ through أَبْصِرْ/أَسْمِعْ to وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِى حُكْمِهِ أَحَدًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is concealed from creatures is fully apprehended by God, and that asymmetry grounds an unshared power to judge. Knowledge, perception, and judgment form one sovereignty rather than three detached predicates.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the positive epistemic pole and makes superior knowledge operative rather than merely honorific.
Concealment from eyes defines the domain unavailable to creaturely inspection.
Eye-sight contributes direct apprehension and counters the hiddenness just named.
Auditory perception broadens complete apprehension beyond a single sensory channel.
Partnership supplies the relation explicitly excluded from the exercise of judgment.
Judging between people supplies the decisional domain reserved to the fully knowing perceiver.
Exhaustive negation closes the possibility of even one participating adjudicator.

changed_reading.before: God knows the answer, sees and hears, and rules alone.
changed_reading.after: Because the whole hidden domain is directly apprehended by God, the verse moves causally from epistemic asymmetry to exclusive adjudicative authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ followed by the ban on partnership in His judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The denied alternative is not only another deity in the abstract. A wali is both unfailing proximity and active charge of an affair; the following no-partnership clause prevents that protective administration from being divided among independent agents.

activation_trace.role: Otherness supplies the excluded outside source of protection.
Nearness without an interval gives guardianship its intimate spatial force.
Taking charge of an affair converts proximity into practical administration.
Participation is excluded, so instrumental helpers cannot become independent co-governors.
Restraint and repulsion for repair frames rule as protective ordering as well as verdict.

changed_reading.before: People have no protector besides God, who admits no partner in rule.
changed_reading.after: The verse denies any independently near manager of their affair: protective presence and corrective governance are one undivided function.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The initial imperative قُلْ governs a formula that joins superior knowledge to the exclusion of any co-judge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The answer is designed for utterance, not private possession. Speech publicly marks where warranted knowledge ends and trains the hearer to accept the resulting limit on claims and authority.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance makes the epistemic boundary a public declaration.
A distinguishing mark that guides gives the declaration a boundary-setting function.
Understanding and compliance make hearing the intended human response to the proclaimed limit.
Corrective restraint turns the formula into discipline for speech and judgment.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is told to recite the correct answer.
changed_reading.after: The speaker is told to publish a usable boundary: affirm the divine source of knowledge and stop human speech from becoming co-judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context stages exhaustive reckoning, a day-level estimate corrected to the Lord's knowledge, conjecture cast into the unseen, and then an explicit hundred-based number plus nine. The focus formula therefore audits the provenance of the numeral: a disclosed count may be stated, while autonomous access to the elapsed interval remains unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Remaining in a place anchors the delta in the focus question about elapsed residence.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the focus claim that adjudicates all proposed measurements.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies the human counting test against which superior knowledge is distinguished.
Repeated staying links the question, the day-level estimate, and the corrected object of knowledge in one exchange.
Disclosure to a knower marks the sleepers' own move from estimate to their Lord's superior knowledge.
Speaking by conjecture into the unseen identifies the failed epistemic mechanism surrounding numerical claims.
Concealment from human sight names the domain at which conjectural counting is aimed.
Reaching one hundred supplies the explicit magnitude immediately before the provenance formula.
The number nine supplies the explicit increment whose authority the next verse locates in divine knowledge.

structural_cues: 18:12 sets knowing against which party can enumerate the terminal span.
18:19 repeats the focus duration-and-superior-knowledge clause after estimates of a day or part of a day.
18:22 labels nearby count-speech conjecture into the unseen and restricts dispute.
18:25 gives a precise duration immediately before 18:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, failed estimate, self-correction, conjecture, and a precise numeral; I infer that 18:26 certifies the number's divine provenance rather than retracting 18:25. A live alternative is a simpler redirection of disputed chronology to omniscience.

changed_reading.before: God alone knows the disputed length of the sleepers' stay.
changed_reading.after: The verse distinguishes a divinely disclosed count from every creaturely route to it: the numeral can be voiced, but its warrant cannot be independently reproduced by estimation or dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human access is alternately withheld, made misleading, and opened: ears are put out of reception, visible bodies look awake while sleeping, inspection produces terror rather than comprehension, and later the hidden sleepers are made discoverable so others know. Divine seeing and hearing in the focus verse are thus contrasted with creaturely channels whose availability and reliability are governed.

activation_trace.role: Concealment from eyes anchors the model in the focus domain of inaccessible information.
Direct eye-sight supplies the stable divine apprehension contrasted with unstable human seeing.
Auditory perception supplies the second stable channel contrasted with the sleepers' closed reception.
Withholding and restraint supplies the functional effect of the action placed upon their ears.
The ear as bodily organ locates the withholding at the channel of hearing.
Supposition marks the observer's visible inference as corrigible rather than knowledge.
Wakefulness supplies the misleading visible state attributed by the observer.
Sleep and stillness supply the concealed state that contradicts the observer's supposition.
Inspection and uncovering supply an attempted access that yields fear rather than understanding.
Discovery of what was hidden reverses the earlier closure of access.
Disclosure to knowers states the public epistemic result of making the sleepers discoverable.

structural_cues: 18:11 attributes the closure of the sleepers' ears to a first-person divine action.
18:18 explicitly opposes what an observer would suppose from sight to the sleepers' actual state.
18:21 makes discovery produce knowledge of the promise and hour.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory closure, deceptive appearance, attempted inspection, later discovery, and resulting knowledge; I infer a controlled-access sequence that contrasts human channels with divine apprehension. A live alternative treats each event only as local protection without a general epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The exclamation simply praises how perfectly God sees and hears.
changed_reading.after: It also seals a demonstration that creaturely sight and hearing can be closed, misdirected, or opened, while divine apprehension remains continuous and governs when hidden reality becomes knowable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The youths seek an embracing refuge and right arrangement of their affair; the request is restated with mercy and practical benefit, and the environmental scene culminates in the exact denial of any guiding wali for one left astray. The focus denial of another wali therefore names the exclusive agent whose guardianship the narrative has enacted.

activation_trace.role: Otherness excludes any independent refuge-provider outside God.
Taking charge of an affair anchors the narrative acts as guardianship rather than incidental aid.
Joining a sheltering side supplies the youths' initial movement into refuge.
Preparation and repair of an affair specifies the practical form of requested care.
Hitting the right face of an affair defines successful guardianship as sound arrangement.
Merciful tenderness supplies the affective source of the protection.
Preparation and repair repeat the expectation that their affair will be actively ordered.
Practical benefit gives the arranged protection a usable outcome.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the exact prior guardian whose absence is paired with misguidance.
Straight guidance away from error identifies the denied wali specifically as a guide.

structural_cues: 18:10 joins refuge, mercy, preparation of their affair, and right direction in one request.
18:16 repeats refuge, mercy, preparation, and benefit before the sun-and-cave protection scene.
18:17 ends that scene by denying a guiding wali to one whom God lets stray.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies requested refuge, prepared benefit, guidance, and the prior no-wali formula; I infer that the intervening preservation is the enacted answer and that 18:26 names its sole administrator. A live alternative leaves wali at generic patronage and treats the cave as only a means.

changed_reading.after: The denial closes a demonstrated pattern: refuge becomes mercy, environmental preservation, and right arrangement only under the one who takes charge of the affair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus verse, a speaker may not bind a future act by categorical speech; doing tomorrow is conditioned by divine willing. The following ban on partnership in God's judgment therefore reaches beyond settling disputes to the executability of plans: human action remains real, but no human declaration independently fixes the future.

activation_trace.role: Participation supplies the co-authorship relation excluded from divine judgment.
Decisive judgment supplies the focus anchor for what can bind an outcome.
Exhaustive negation prevents any planner from becoming an independent co-decider.
Voiced utterance supplies the categorical future claim that is restrained.
Producing an act supplies the real intended action whose occurrence is not independently secured.
The next day supplies the future interval the speaker cannot categorically possess.
Willing attached to the thing supplies the stated condition under which the planned act reaches occurrence.

structural_cues: 18:23 prohibits saying that a specified act will certainly be done tomorrow.
18:24 immediately supplies the exception of divine willing.
18:26 then denies every participant in God's judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future speech, intended action, tomorrow, the divine-will condition, and the adjacent unshared judgment clause; I infer that hukm includes effective determination of outcomes. A live alternative keeps hukm narrowly judicial and treats the adjacency as ethical framing rather than semantic expansion.

changed_reading.before: God admits no partner when He judges.
changed_reading.after: No speaker can turn intention into an independently binding future decree: planning operates inside, and never alongside, God's effective judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because قُلْ is ordinarily carried by the ق و ل speech analysis, while littleness comes from the packet's secondary ق ل ل mapping and is not asserted as the word's historical derivation here. It remains anchored because that secondary mapping is explicitly supplied for 18:26:1 and 18:22 activates the same mapped branch with 'few' amid unseen count-dispute. Downstream prose should label it a branch resonance or sound-level pressure toward economy of claim, never the primary lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُلْ at 18:26:1, through both the ordinary ق و ل target and the packet-supplied secondary ق ل ل target.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance preserves the ordinary imperative anchor for the reading.
Littleness and paucity add an exploratory pressure toward saying only the bounded formula.
The few who know activate the same paucity branch inside the immediate scene of disputed counts.
Sharp disputation supplies the excess of speech against which epistemic economy becomes functional.
Concealment from human sight defines the boundary at which restrained speech is warranted.

changed_reading.before: Say the correct proposition about God's knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the command also enacts economy at the unseen boundary: utter the warranted formula and make little speech beyond it.

strongest_changes: The exact duration in 18:25 and the superior-knowledge formula in 18:26 coexist as disclosed datum and provenance rule, not necessarily statement and retraction.
The cave sequence turns divine sight and hearing into a contrast with human sensory channels that are closed, made misleading, and later opened.
The repeated no-wali construction makes exclusive guardianship a demonstrated right arrangement of the youths' affair, while 18:23-24 extends unshared judgment into future agency.
summary.what_was_special: This focus ayah is a closure node: it repeats the sleepers' own correction in 18:19, answers the counting and unseen-dispute sequence, gathers the sensory-management plot into divine apprehension, repeats the guardian denial from 18:17, and follows the divine-will condition without collapsing those mechanisms into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 18:26 positively certifies the precise duration in 18:25 or more generally declines independent chronological adjudication remains live.
The extension of حُكْم from judicial decision to effective determination of tomorrow is strongly activated by adjacency but is still an inferred semantic broadening.
The قُلْ/قِلّة outlier depends on a packet-supplied secondary mapping and should remain exploratory rather than lexicalized.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Knowledge and rule are one exclusive field.** `ع ل م` B001 (“knowing as clear disclosure”) opens the ayah, while `ش ر ك` B001 (“sharing and partnership”) is denied in judgment. Later the hidden teacher’s unexplained acts (18:65–82) and the barrier’s temporary durability (18:98) show action governed by knowledge unavailable to observers. I infer that unshared judgment follows from unshared epistemic scope. The claim is administrative, not merely informational.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:82 and 18:91 sharpened unshared judgment as action grounded in a wider informational field.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Sight as penetrating witness, paired with hearing.** `ب ص ر/B001` supplies ocular seeing, while `ب ص ر/B002` supplies inner sight, certainty, and proof. The command pairs `أَبْصِرْ` with `أَسْمِعْ` after failed conjectural counting (18:22) and before recitation of revelation (18:27); 18:28 then disciplines where the eyes may range. I infer that the exclamatory pair integrates complete modes of access rather than describing two organs. The ayah reads as epistemic correction: divine knowing penetrates what human estimates only circle.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:27–28 moved complete sight from claim to practice: revealed words are recited and the human gaze is kept from overreaching.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه سمو الشيء وعلوه، وارتفاع البصر، وعلو الحسيب والشريف، ورفعة الذكر.
يدخل فيه الشيء أو الشخص الذي يرتفع فيلوح من بعيد، وسماوة الهلال أو كل شيء بمعنى شخصه العالي الظاهر.
يدخل فيه سما الفحل إذا تطاول أو سطا على شوله، أي علاها وتخللها.
يدخل فيه السماء لما علا وأظل، والسقف، والسحاب، والمطر، والنبات المنسوب إلى المطر، وظهر الفرس أو أعلى الشيء.
يدخل فيه الاسم والتسمية والتسمي والأسامي، والسمي بمعنى الموافق في الاسم أو النظير المستحق للاسم.
يدخل فيه سما القوم أو استموا إذا خرجوا للصيد، والسماة الصيادون، وما لحق بذلك من طلب الوحش وآلة الصياد.
يدخل فيه تسامى القوم إذا تباروا، والمساماة بمعنى المفاخرة والمباراة والمعارضة، ومن لا يسامى إذا لا يقدر على مجاراته.
يدخل فيه سماه بمعنى صوته أو صيته في الخير لا في الشر.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التوسم والتفرس، ورؤية أثر الخير أو الشر في الشخص، والآيات للمتوسمين بوصفهم ناظرين في السمة الدالة.
يدخل فيه الوسمي، وهو المطر الأول أو مطر أول السنة أو الربيع الأول، وتسميته لأنه يسم الأرض بالنبات، والأرض الموسومة التي أصابها الوسمي.
يدخل فيه موسم الحج ومواسم أسواق العرب، والمجمع أو الوقت المعلم الذي يجتمع إليه الناس، ووسم الناس بمعنى شهدوا الموسم.
يدخل فيه الوسامة، والوسيم والوسيمة، وذات ميسم، أي الحسن أو أثر الجمال والعتق الظاهر على الشخص.
يدخل فيه الوسم أو الوسمة اسم شجرة أو نبات ورقه خضاب، والعظلم الذي يختضب به.

concept_map.definition: Gözle görme alanı: görme duyusu, bakan göz organı, bir şeyi gözle görmek ve gözün görmeye açılması. Dikkatle dikilerek bakma veya yavrunun gözünün açılması gibi kullanımlar bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Görme duyusu, bakan göz organı ve bir şeyi gözle görme eylemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
Görme yetisine sahip kişi kör olanın karşıtı olarak adlandırılır.
Dikkatle ve keskin biçimde bakma, görme çekirdeğine bağlı kalıplaşmış bir kullanımdır.
Yavrunun gözünün açılıp görmeye hazır hale gelmesi de görme alanına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak malzemesi bu dalı bedensel görmeye bağlar: göz organı, görme duyusu, gözle görme eylemi ve görme yetisi olan kişi. Aynı toplu iddia ayrıca yoğun bakış kalıbını ve yavrunun gözünün açılmasını çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Kalbin veya zihnin bir şeyi bilip kavraması, doğruluğa ermesi ve bunun delil, ibret ya da açıklayıcı kanıt olarak görünmesi. Din veya belirli bir iş konusunda bilinçli hale gelme bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أحدهما العلم بالشيء وبصرت بالشيء إذا صرت به بصيرا عالما والبصيرة البرهان (maqayis)؛ البصر نفاذ في القلب والبصيرة اسم لما اعتقد في القلب من الدين وحقيق الأمر واستبصر في أمره ودينه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ حسن البصيرة إذا كان مستبصرا في دينه (jamhara)؛ البصر العلم وبصرت بالشيء علمته والتبصر التأمل والتعرف والبصيرة الحجة والاستبصار في الشيء (sihah)؛ لقوة القلب المدركة بصيرة وبصر وعلى معرفة وتحقق (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما يوصف بأنه مبصر بمعنى مضيء أو بين أو مبصر به أو جاعل للناس بصراء، والتبصرة بمعنى التبيين.
يدخل فيه البصيرة من الدم: القطعة أو الطريقة أو المقدار على الأرض أو الجسد، وما اتصل بها من ثأر أو دية في الشعر.
يدخل فيه البصيرة بمعنى الترس أو الدرع وكل ما لبس من السلاح إذا سمي بصائر.
يدخل فيه غلظ الشيء وجلده أو جانبه وحرفه، وخياطة أديم إلى أديم أو ما بين شقتي البيت أو الثوب أو المزادة، والقطعة الملفقة.
يدخل فيه البصرة والبصر بمعنى الحجارة الرخوة أو البراقة أو المائلة إلى البياض، والأرض المسماة بذلك، ومنه تسمية البصرة والإتيان إليها.

Dallar eş adlı ve kısmen imgesel bağlantılar taşısa da her biri kendi madde, eylem veya kavrayış alanında sınırlandırılmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli yapılarda hem bir ölçü veya düzeyin altında kalanı hem de anılan kişi ya da varlığın dışındakini gösterir. Bu nedenle başkalık çerçevesi geçerlidir, fakat düzeyce aşağı olma anlamı silinmemeli ve dal yalın bir başkalık sözcüğü gibi sunulmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal bütünüyle belirli yapılara bağlıdır; başkası, dışında veya daha aşağı karşılıkları yalın biçime genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yalnızca belirli yapılarda, bir ölçütün veya kişinin düzeyine ulaşamayanı ya da anılan kişi ve varlığın dışında kalanı gösterir. Bağlama göre karşılaştırmalı azlık, alt konum veya başkalık öne çıkar.

facets.statement: Belirli bir yapıda anılan kişi veya varlığın dışında kalan başkası gösterilir.
Karşılaştırılan miktar veya düzey, belirtilen ölçüden daha az ya da aşağı olabilir.
Kişiler arasındaki konum farkı, bir grubun muhatabın düzeyine erişmemesi biçiminde ifade edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek aktarım, yapı içindeki anlamı başkalık ile daha düşük miktar veya konum arasında dağıtır. Kişinin düzeyine erişemeyenler, belirtilen ölçüden daha azı ve anılan varlığın dışındakiler bu sınır içinde değerlendirilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, insanlar arasında karar vermeyi ve bir şeyin öyle olup olmadığına karar bağlamayı açıkça destekler. Yaralanma bedelini hesaplama gibi özel uygulamalar ayrı sözcük birimlerinde görülür; bunlar dalın genel çekirdeği değil, yargısal karar vermenin özel kullanımlarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım karar verme çekirdeğini verir; kişiler arasında karar verme, biri lehine karar verme ve bir karar merciine başvurma yapıları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlar arasındaki bir uyuşmazlığı doğru ölçüye göre bağlayıcı bir kararla sonuçlandırmak veya bir şeyin öyle olup olmadığına karar vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, insanlar arasındaki uyuşmazlığı bağlayıcı bir kararla sona erdirmektir.
Karar verme, bir durumun belirli biçimde olduğunu ya da olmadığını saptamaya da uzanır.
Tarafların yetkili bir karar merciine başvurması, kararın kendisi değil bu sürece giriş eylemidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, insanlar arasında karar vermeyi, haksızlığı önleyen bir sonuç üretmeyi ve bir durumun öyle olup olmadığını karara bağlamayı ortaklaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanlar arasındaki karar verme çekirdeğini doğal biçimde karşılar ve salt engellemeden ayrılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyuşmazlığı bağlayıcı bir kararla sona erdirme çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyin öyle olup olmadığına karar verme uzantısını açıkça söylemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki ya da daha çok taraf arasındaki çekişmenin karara bağlandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar arasında karar verme işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir savın doğru olup olmadığını belirleme uzantısını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne, olay veya sav hakkında olumlu ya da olumsuz belirleme yapıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir durumun öyle olup olmadığını karara bağlama yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsanlar arasındaki uyuşmazlığı sonuçlandırma çekirdeğini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bir durumun öyle olup olmadığını belirleme kullanımını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, doğru ile yanlışı keskin biçimde ayırma ve son sözü söyleme görüntüsünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da çekişen taraflar arasında ayırıcı ve sonuçlandırıcı karar vermeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekler büyük ölçüde örtüşür; odak dal belirleme anlamına uzanırken komşu dal ayırıp sonuca bağlama yönünü daha belirgin taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kararın içeriğini ve bir sav hakkında belirleme yapmayı birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, uyuşmazlığı açıp çözerek kapatan karar verici kişiyi de adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın merkezinde çekişen taraflar arasında karar vererek uyuşmazlığı bitirmek bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın önerme hakkında karar verme uzantısı daha geniştir; komşu dal ise açıp ayırarak çözme görüntüsüne ve karar vericiye bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bağlayıcı kararın verilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal karar verme yetkisinin bir kişiye bırakılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir kişi karar verme görevini üstlenebilir ve taraflar bu karara bağlanabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Karar verme eylemi ile o eylemi yapma yetkisinin başkasına bırakılması farklı aşamalardır; biri diğerini gerektirebilir ama tanımlamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen ilişkiler karar verme çekirdeğini yakın karar dallarından ve yetki devrinden ayıran en yararlı karşılaştırmalardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sözcüğün olumsuzluk içinde konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişilerin bütün türünü kapsadığını ve yalnız tek kişiyi değil iki ya da daha çok kişiyi de dışladığını açıkça belirtir. Hazırlanan dal çerçevesi bu kapsamı doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın birimin olumsuz cümledeki kapsamına bağlıdır ve başka bir söz öbeğine özgü anlamı bu dala taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Olumsuz bir cümlede, söz konusu olabilecek kişilerden bir tekinin bile bulunmadığını ya da eyleme katılmadığını bildirir. Kapsam yalnız bir kişiyi değil, iki ve daha çok kişiyi de dışarıda bırakır.

facets.statement: Olumsuzluk altında konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişiler türünün tamamını kapsar.
Bir kişinin yanı sıra iki veya daha çok kişinin varlığını ya da katılımını da dışlar.
Bir yerde hiç kimsenin bulunmadığını veya bir eylemi hiç kimsenin yapmadığını söyleyen cümlelerde gerçekleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar olumsuzluk içindeki kullanımın kişi türünü bütünüyle kapsadığı konusunda birleşir. Böylece söz yalnız tek bir kişinin yokluğunu değil, o türe giren herhangi bir sayıda kişinin bulunmamasını da bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Olumsuzluk altında kişi türünün tamamını, sayı ayrımı yapmadan dışlayan doğal dal karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumsuzluk, kişi kapsamı ve birden çok kişiyi de dışlama birlikte korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yerde kişi bulunmadığını bildiren varlık cümlelerinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişilerin tümünü olumsuzluk altında dışlama kapsamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir eyleme katılmama gibi yer bildirmeyen olumsuz bağlamları kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir insan topluluğunun hiçbir üyesinin eyleme katılmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir topluluğun bütün üyelerini olumsuzluk kapsamına alır.
error_profile.loses: Belirsiz bir yerde insan bulunmaması gibi topluluğu belirtilmeyen bağlamları kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal olumsuzluk altında kişi türünün tamamını düzenli bir dil bilgisel kapsamla dışlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir yerde insanın ya da kimi kullanımlarda herhangi bir izin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıplaşmış sözleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bir yerde kimse ya da iz bulunmaması
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir yerde kişinin bulunmadığını söyleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kişi türünü olumsuzlukla kapsayan genel birimdir; komşu dal ise belirli kalıplaşmış sözlerle yerin boşluğunu, bazen de iz yokluğunu anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnız konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişilerin tümünü dışlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kalıplaşmış bir sözle kişi, herhangi bir şey veya su gibi farklı varlıkların en küçüğünü bile dışlayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: en küçük kişi ya da şeyin bile yokluğu
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da olumsuzlukta en küçük bir örneğin bile bulunmadığını bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın alanı kişilerdir; komşu dalın kalıplaşmış kullanımı kişi dışındaki şeylere ve suya kadar genişleyebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal olumsuzluk altında herhangi bir kişinin varlığını ya da katılımını dışlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal olumlu biçimde bir tane, tek veya eşi olmayan olmayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın biçiminde bir kişiye ya da varlığa ilişkin birlik düşüncesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın anlamı olumsuzluk ve bütün kişileri kapsama koşuluna bağlıdır; komşu dal olumlu tekliği veya eşsizliği anlatır.
